statement: The Epoch Capabilities Index gain in 2027 is < 50% of its 2025 gain (Epoch AI; resolves 2028-01)
status_at_phase_end: Not resolvable until 2028-01, but the 2026 trajectory points toward NO. Baseline: 2025 frontier ECI gain ~12.4 points (o1 142.7 at end-2024 -> GPT-5.2 Pro 155.1, Dec 2025; frequentist scale), so YES needs a 2027 gain < ~6.2. By mid-Nov 2026 the frontier had moved ~14-18 points YTD (~169 in Sept, ~173 for a model released 2026-11-09, on the Nov 2026 Bayesian refit; mixed-scale comparison, ~1 pt error). Epoch finds the post-reasoning trend linear at ~14-17 pts/yr with no sign of slowdown. Caveat: index refits revise history; the 2025 baseline must be recomputed on the scale in force at resolution.

items.summary: First 2026 frontier record on the ECI: 156.2, about +1.2 over the end-2025 frontier (155.1).
items.detail: OpenAI GPT-5.3 Codex, released 2026-02-05, ECI 156.22 (90% CI 153.70-159.65), per Epoch Data Insight table (frequentist scale, Sept 2026). Date is model release; Epoch scoring typically follows by days to weeks.

items.summary: Frontier ECI reached 161.7 in April 2026, +6.6 over end-2025 within four months - already above half of the full 2025 gain.
items.detail: GPT-5.4 Pro 158.55 (2026-03-05); GPT-5.5 Pro 161.71 (2026-04-23). Epoch Data Insight table.

items.summary: Epoch report finds three of four capability metrics (ECI, time horizon, math index) accelerated, best fit by separate reasoning/non-reasoning linear trends with the reasoning trend 2-3x faster; no evidence of a plateau.
items.detail: Epoch AI report 'Have AI capabilities accelerated?' (Denain, Barry), 2026-04-16. Only WeirdML V2 is best fit by a global linear trend.

items.summary: Mid-year frontier ECI 162.5 (frequentist scale), +7.4 over end-2025; pace slowed in May-June relative to Jan-April.
items.detail: Anthropic Claude Fable 5, released 2026-06-09, ECI 162.48 (CI 159.33-165.76). Later Bayesian refit lists it at 164.1.

items.summary: Epoch: since reasoning models (Sept 2024) the ECI frontier has advanced linearly at ~14 points per year, vs ~6 per year before. A 2027 gain below ~6.2 (half of 2025) would require reverting to the pre-reasoning pace.
items.detail: Epoch Data Insight 'The ECI frontier has advanced by 14 points per year since the introduction of reasoning models' (Alexander Barry), 2026-09-01. 13 reasoning SOTA points; 2025 SOTA path o1 142.67 (2024-12-17) -> GPT-5.2 Pro 155.07 (2025-12-11).

items.summary: September 2026 releases from two Bloc A developers set new records at ~168.5-169 ECI (Nov 2026 scale), roughly +13 over end-2025.
items.detail: GPT-6 Astra 169.0; Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol 168.5 (Sept 2026), as shown in third-party mirrors of Epoch ECI data (aisocratic.org leaderboard). Exact release days not verified; month only.

items.summary: Epoch switched the ECI to a Bayesian fit: frontier values move ~1 point on average (models above 150 mostly up by ~0.7), reasoning-era slope 16.6 pts/yr (vs 15.7 frequentist). Historical baselines can shift, so the 2025 gain should be recomputed on the scale in force at resolution.
items.detail: Epoch AI report 'Updating the ECI methodology to use a Bayesian model' (Alvarez, Barry), 2026-11-04. Anchors unchanged: Claude 3.5 Sonnet = 130, GPT-5 = 150.

items.summary: A model released 2026-11-09 by a Bloc A developer is listed at ECI 173.4, ~+18 over end-2025 (mixed-scale comparison). As-of caveat: the score appears in mirrors dated 2026-11-16, after the phase end; whether Epoch had published it by 2026-11-14 is unverified.
items.detail: Anthropic Claude Fable 5.2 (system card 2026-11-09), ECI 173.4 per models.fru.dev mirror 'published Nov 16, 2026' and aisocratic.org. Treat as provisional for the 2026 phase.
